description: The road less traveled is not for everyone, it’s a conscious choice that you make to yourself #selflove #selflovejourney #confidence
transcript: There are pros and cons to everything. When you choose to travel the road that is less traveled, things get sticky. It is not easy and requires a lot of sacrifice. Sacrifice looks different to everyone. You have to make a conscious effort. You have to have a real uncomfortable conversation with yourself as to if this is what you are going to do. When you are charting a path, the standards change. The game changes.
